# Security boundary

ONBOARD·OS is a browser-based portfolio prototype. The current v18.0.0 release inherits the S1–S8 security/failure-containment contract introduced in v7 and continues to validate the controls that are meaningful for this scope: CSP and response-header configuration, analytics payload allowlisting, URL/storage/console privacy boundaries, telemetry failure containment, unsafe DOM sink checks, dependency audit, and pinned GitHub Actions. It does not claim production identity, authorization, secret-management, backend, or SaaS API security because those systems are intentionally not implemented in this prototype. `release.json` remains the canonical release source; this document describes the security boundary, not a separate release version.
